title: Tech Trends 2012: Elevate IT for digital business
notes: Preface: 'We select as trends those topics that have the most potential to impact businesses over the next 18 to 24 months.' Ten trends in two categories, Disruptors (1-5) and Enablers (6-10). Quotes are the chapter subtitles. Read from the Wayback Machine copy of the US PDF (the Deloitte Global copy gx-cons-tech-trends-2012-elevate-digital-business.pdf was only captured as 404). published month from the file name stamp 013112 (31 January 2012); approximate.
